name: nanamica

prices.note: Polos & tees collection, US store: 21 listings, 2 polos plus a camisole and a tank excluded; 17 tees, none marked down. Low nanamica Loopwheel COOLMAX Jersey Tee $90 (50/50 cotton and COOLMAX, knitted on a loopwheel machine, nanamica logo embroidered); COOLMAX Jersey Pocket Tee $120 ('signature short sleeve T-shirt', organic cotton and COOLMAX EcoMade); OOAL Pocket Tee $150; high OOAL Rayon Cotton Long Sleeve Tee $250. notes: US store run by nanamica USA inc. (nanamica NEW YORK). Shipping policy: ships to the 50 US states and Canada (no US territories, PO boxes or APO/FPO); UPS Ground free from $200, $10 below; store pick-up at nanamica NEW YORK same day.
Refund policy: no returns or exchanges after 14 days of delivery; discounted items final sale; returns need email authorization first.

About page: 'Taking UTILITY and SPORTS as key words, nanamica mixes fashion and functionality at a high level to offer standard wear for the current age with neutral design'; founder Eiichiro Homma; makes THE NORTH FACE Purple Label with Goldwin in Japan; co-develops Cotton GORE-TEX with Gore Japan. Store list: Daikanyama, Kyoto, Kobe, Fukuoka and New York, so hq_country JP.
